title: Valtellina Wine Trail Half: 21.7km / 914m D+, target sub-2h00
terrain: Chiuro to Sondrio, vineyard terraces, start 10:00

steps.target: Z1-Z2, 130-150bpm jog + 3 strides, finish 15min before gun
Z3, 155-165bpm, settle, do not race the start
Z3-Z4, 163-172bpm on climbs, relaxed fast descents

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: first 20min cap 165bpm (Pirin cramps came from the start). Climbs 163-172bpm, hike over 15% grade. Descents 172+ spm, quick feet. From ~1h30 open to 175+.
FUEL: breakfast 07:00 (100-120g carb). 1 gel 10min before start. 500ml flask Tailwind (50g) + gels at 40min and 80min = ~70g/h. Water at every aid.
GARMIN: ~300+.
STOP RULE: knee or calf signal = drop to hike-run, finish.
WHY: sub-2h00 needs ~5:30/km average; the time is won in the last 40min, not the first 20.
